title: Miss Sarajevo
creator: Bill Carter
description: A short documentary by Bill Carter, an American aid worker, on daily life during the siege, including a beauty contest held in 1993 whose contestants held up a banner: “Don’t let them kill us.” It inspired the U2 song.

title: Welcome to Sarajevo
creator: Michael Winterbottom
description: Based on the true story of a British television reporter who smuggled a girl out of an orphanage during the siege. The journalists in the film live and work in the Holiday Inn, as the real ones did.

title: In the Land of Blood and Honey
creator: Angelina Jolie
description: Angelina Jolie’s first film as a director, about a Bosniak woman and a Bosnian Serb officer whose relationship is caught up in the war. It was shot in English and in Bosnian, with local actors.

title: No Man’s Land
creator: Danis Tanović
description: A Bosniak and a Bosnian Serb soldier are trapped in a trench between the lines, while UN peacekeepers and the press fail to help. A dark comedy by Danis Tanović, who filmed the siege as a documentary maker. It won the Oscar for foreign-language film.

title: Grbavica
creator: Jasmila Žbanić
description: A single mother in postwar Sarajevo hides from her teenage daughter the truth about how she was conceived during the war. Set in Grbavica, a neighborhood held by Bosnian Serb forces during the siege. It won the Golden Bear in Berlin.

title: Death in Sarajevo
creator: Danis Tanović
description: One day at the Hotel Europe, as staff prepare for a ceremony marking 100 years since the 1914 assassination, and the workers threaten to strike. Based on a play by the French writer Bernard-Henri Lévy.

title: Quo Vadis, Aida?
creator: Jasmila Žbanić
description: A UN interpreter tries to save her husband and sons as Bosnian Serb forces take Srebrenica in July 1995 and kill more than 8,000 Bosniak men and boys. Directed by Jasmila Žbanić of Sarajevo. The memorial is about three hours east of the city.
